name: Open-Air Rock Site Management Benchmark
description: Defines standards and measurable criteria for assessing open-air rock site management practices (safety, stability monitoring, erosion control, and remediation performance).
reputation: Domain-specific standards document used by practitioners and researchers in geology/engineering for assessing open-air rock site management; adopted in applied settings but not an ML benchmark.
notes: Not an ML dataset — intended for human/site assessments and field inspections; metrics rely on expert judgment and physical measurements; applicability is domain-specific.
